_comment: A golden moment: the shape the regression harness expects.
Replace this with 20-30 real moments exported from the seeding session (clause 6, 'the cold
start'). They are the fixed set every library change is measured against, so they should be
genuinely representative — strong scenes AND thin ones, because a library change that improves
the strong ones while breaking the thin ones is not an improvement.
`entry` must contain ONLY fields the drafter is allowed to see (9.1). The claim verifier checks
every span against exactly these strings, so they must be the real text, not a paraphrase.
audience: founders selling into enterprise for the first time

entry.the_moment: On a call last Tuesday the CFO put his hand up halfway through the deck and asked what happens when the champion leaves.
entry.the_detail: He did not ask it aggressively. He asked it like someone who had been burned before and was checking whether I had thought about it.
entry.their_actual_words: what happens when the champion leaves
entry.how_he_felt: Caught out. I had an answer but it was a platitude and I could hear it as I said it.
entry.the_realisation: Every deal I have lost late had one person holding it up, and I had never once mapped that as a risk.
entry.the_lesson: A deal with one advocate is not a pipeline entry, it is a bet on someone staying in their job.
entry.what_changed: I now ask who else would have to agree if the champion left tomorrow.
